I've been a paying customer for almost two years now and I feel like I need to write a full account of what happened this week because it has genuinely been one frustration after another. It started on Monday when I tried to log in first thing in the morning and the app simply would not accept my password. I was certain it was correct because I use a password manager, so I clicked the reset link. The reset email took nearly forty minutes to arrive, and by the time it did the link had apparently already expired, which makes no sense to me. I requested another one, waited again, and finally managed to get in around lunchtime. Once I was in, I noticed that my dashboard was showing completely wrong numbers. My monthly total was displaying as a negative value, which is obviously impossible given that I only ever add income entries. I took screenshots in case you need them. Then, when I tried to export a report to send to my accountant, the export produced a blank PDF three times in a row. At this point I contacted support through the form on your website because there is no phone number and no live chat that I could find anywhere. That was Monday afternoon. It is now Thursday and I have still not received any response, not even an automated acknowledgement that my ticket was received, which makes me wonder if it went through at all. I understand that bugs happen and that support teams get busy, but the combination of a login problem, incorrect financial data, a broken export, and total silence from support has left me seriously considering whether to renew my subscription next month. I really do like the product when it works, and that is why I am taking the time to write all of this instead of just leaving a one-star review and walking away. Please look into all of these issues and let me know what is going on.

First off I want to say that the core idea of this product is excellent and when everything is functioning I genuinely enjoy using it, so please take this feedback as coming from someone who wants you to succeed. That said, the performance over the last month has been steadily getting worse and I want to describe it in detail. When I open the application in the morning it now takes somewhere between eight and twelve seconds just to load the main dashboard, whereas a couple of months ago it was almost instant. Once it loads, scrolling through my list of items is choppy and stutters, especially when there are images involved. If I have more than a few tabs of the web version open, my browser starts warning me that the page is slowing everything down, and the desktop app on my laptop keeps my fan running constantly and reports very high memory usage in the task manager, often over four gigabytes which seems excessive for what is essentially a list and some charts. On top of the general sluggishness, larger exports frequently time out entirely, so I have started breaking my reports into smaller chunks as a workaround, which is tedious and adds a good twenty minutes to a task that used to take five. I have tried all of the usual troubleshooting steps that I could think of: clearing the cache repeatedly, fully uninstalling and reinstalling both the mobile and desktop apps, switching between Chrome and Firefox, disabling my browser extensions one by one, restarting my machine, and even testing on a completely different computer at home, and it helps only marginally and only for a little while before the sluggishness creeps back in. I am on a reasonably powerful and recent computer with a fast and stable fibre internet connection, so I really do not think the problem is on my end, and the fact that it has been getting progressively worse over the same period rather than suddenly appearing points to something changing on your side. I would really appreciate it if the engineering team could seriously look into these performance regressions, because it is starting to meaningfully affect my daily workflow and productivity, and I know at least three or four colleagues in my organisation who have independently complained about the exact same gradual slowdown over the exact same time frame, which suggests it is not an isolated case.

I'm writing to give some structured feedback after using the platform intensively for a quarter, and I have a mix of praise and requests. Starting with the positives, the onboarding experience was genuinely delightful; the step-by-step walkthrough was clear without being patronising, and I was productive within about ten minutes of signing up, which is rare for tools in this space. The core reporting features are powerful and I have replaced two other subscriptions with this single product, so overall I am a happy customer. Now for the things I would love to see improved, because I think they would take the product from good to indispensable. First, the search functionality really needs filters; right now searching returns a long undifferentiated list and I cannot narrow by date range, category, or status, so for large accounts like mine it becomes impractical and I end up scrolling endlessly. Second, an integration with Slack would be transformative for my team because we currently copy and paste updates manually several times a day, which is error prone. Third, the approval workflow has too many steps; approving a single item takes five clicks and for someone who approves dozens of items a day that adds up to a lot of wasted time, so a bulk-approve option or a streamlined flow would be hugely appreciated. Fourth, and more minor, it would be lovely to be able to schedule reports to be generated and emailed automatically on a recurring basis, for example every Monday morning, so that I do not have to remember to pull them manually each week. Fifth, an option to reorder or hide columns in the main table view would help enormously, because the fixed column order does not match the priority of information for my particular use case and I find myself scrolling horizontally far too often. None of these are dealbreakers and I want to stress again that I genuinely like the product and consider it good value, but these enhancements would collectively make my daily experience substantially better and would make it much easier for me to wholeheartedly recommend the tool to peers and colleagues in similar roles, which I already do informally whenever the subject comes up in conversation.
